messages:
maria.g: Quick huddle — we need to finalize customer-facing follow-ups after yesterday's partial outage. Who's taking the 72h summary and who approves statuspage text?
ryan.k: I can draft the statuspage entry and a one-paragraph summary. Will avoid deep infra terms.
samir.b: I'll own the RCA sharing policy update and a short redaction checklist for customer documents.
beth: tagging @olivia.p for legal signoff on the sharing policy and consent flow.
olivia.p: Happy to review. Ill prioritize this and send comments by tomorrow EOD.
maria.g: Top priorities: 1) publish a 72h customer summary (short, non-technical); 2) update statuspage wording with a high-level cause + recurrence note; 3) decide criteria for sharing full RCAs vs redacted summaries.
ryan.k: Draft statuspage copy (v1):
```
Partial disruption to hosted inference (Mar 24, 2026)  some customers experienced elevated latencies due to a cache configuration change. Service health restored at 03:18 UTC. We are preparing a customer summary and will provide an update within 72 hours.
```
maria.g: Good start. Please remove the word 'latencies' in favor of 'delays' for broader readability. Also keep cause phrased as 'configuration affecting request caching' rather than implementation details.
ryan.k: Updated line: "...due to a configuration change affecting request caching."
samir.b: Proposed RCA sharing rules:
- Full internal RCA: internal only; enterprise customers may request deeper technical attachments under NDA/consent.
- Redacted customer summary: publish within 72 hours for all impacted customers.
- Full timeline + mitigations: available within 7 business days as a redacted document.
Redaction checklist (short): remove PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, and any sensitive security controls.
olivia.p: Legally this is acceptable. Add an explicit customer consent checkbox for post-incident technical briefings and record consent in our tracker.
beth: I'll draft the consent checkbox language with privacy and hand it to @olivia.p for review.
maria.g: Assignments: 72h summary = maria.g; statuspage update = ryan.k; RCA policy + checklist = samir.b; consent template review = olivia.p + beth.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-4891 "Publish 72h customer summary"  assignee: maria.g  due: 1769400000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-4892 "Statuspage update: caching incident"  assignee: ryan.k  due: 1769301200
samir.b: I'll open COMMS-4893 for the policy doc and link it to infra ticket INFRA-772. Will ping legal when draft is ready.
maria.g: One more public-facing sentence to include: "Were investigating a recurring class of caching-related spikes and will share validated mitigations when available." Keep it high-level.
ryan.k: Will append that sentence once legal approves.
olivia.p: Approve the sentence as-is. For customers requesting deeper detail, they must sign the consent form and we need a log of who received the redacted materials.
beth: I'll create the consent template and a support flow that adds an opt-in checkbox for bridge calls.
maria.g: Support ops note: please ensure support uses identical wording in help replies — ping support when the statuspage copy is merged.
ryan.k: Will submit PR for statuspage and tag support in the description.
samir.b: Tracking note: this is the third related cache incident in six weeks. I'll add a recurring-incident tag and ensure infra adds a long-term remediation owner.
maria.g: Recap and owners:
- Statuspage copy + recurrence line: ryan.k (due in 2 business days)
- 72h public summary: maria.g (due in 72 hours)
- RCA sharing policy + redaction checklist: samir.b (draft to legal by EOD)
- Consent + bridge-call opt-in: beth + olivia.p
- Link policy & infra tickets in the comms tracker: samir.b
incident-bot: COMMS-4893 created: "RCA sharing policy & redaction checklist"  assignee: samir.b  due: 1769350000
maria.g: Thanks all. Ill post the 72h draft here for quick review once its ready. Please keep customer language consistent across channels.
ryan.k: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: COMMS-4892 updated: status set to "in progress"
maria.g: End of thread.
